scripts.setup: docker compose build && npm run data:init
scripts.data:init: docker compose run --rm backend python -m app.cli init-regions
scripts.data:init:offline: docker compose run --rm backend python -m app.cli init-regions --offline
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.check:backend: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && pytest"
scripts.check:frontend: docker compose run --rm --no-deps frontend sh -c "npm run lint && npx tsc -b"
scripts.test:network: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend pytest -m network
